plainText:
Michael Lockwood Crouch is a voice actor for the English-language dub of . He is currently affiliated with Atlas Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Crouch was born in 1984 in Austin, Texas. He has been acting since 2013, only getting voice acting roles on occasion. He has also provided his voice for audiobook narrations. In 2014, he was cast in his best known role as the voice of in .
